title: Deep learning pCLE system diagnoses the Correa cascade of gastric cancer in real time
summary: A deep learning computer-aided diagnosis system (CCADS) was developed on gastric pCLE images and videos from 5771 examinations and tested offline, then in a prospective real-time study of 1254 lesions from 951 patients against blinded expert endoscopists with histopathology as reference. Real-time accuracies were 91.71-97.13% across lesion types; for neoplasms, CCADS sensitivity was 96.70% versus 89.01% for experts (p = 0.044). The abstract does not state the number of sites.
ai_technology: CCADS, a deep learning pCLE computer-aided diagnosis system

evidence.tested: Offline image and video tests and a prospective real-time diagnostic study on consecutive patients (October 2019 to September 2021).
evidence.unknown: Performance in other settings and effect on biopsy numbers or outcomes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies inflammation, atrophy, intestinal metaplasia, intraepithelial neoplasia and cancer in live pCLE.
